name: task_manager_agent
description: A task management agent backed by AlloyDB with AI capabilities. Can create, list, update, and delete tasks. Also supports semantic search, smart filtering, and AI-generated task summaries.

skills.name: Task CRUD Operations
skills.description: Create, list, update, and delete project tasks with fields like title, description, assignee, priority, due date, and tags.

skills.name: Semantic Task Search
skills.description: Find tasks by meaning using vector embeddings in AlloyDB. Use for natural language queries like 'checkout work' or 'client deliverables'.

skills.name: Smart Task Filtering
skills.description: Filter tasks using AI-evaluated conditions for complex questions like 'which tasks are at risk?' or 'frontend-related work'.

skills.name: AI Task Summary
skills.description: Generate standup-style summaries and status reports from tasks using AI.
